passiveBonuses.desc: Hunters generate 20% more food and passively earn gold equal to 25% of food gathered while hunting.
All wooden structures (Lumber Camp, Palisade Walls, wooden towers) have +50% HP.

age2.bonus: All military units produced within 20 tiles gain +10% movement speed permanently.
Friendly structures automatically repair at no wood cost when damaged. Monks trained here are free.

age3.nameKey: Rus Cathedral of Christ the Savior
age3.bonus: Relics stored in the Cathedral generate 2x gold income. Each relic also generates +5 influence per minute.
Scout units reveal a 50% larger area. Scouts passively generate gold equal to 1 gold per minute each.

age4.bonus: Periodically produces free Streltsy units. All defensive towers within 15 tiles gain +3 arrow attacks.
All weapon upgrade technologies researched at this landmark are 50% cheaper. Unlocks unique Rus weapon upgrade tier.

uniqueUnits.special: Bonus damage vs heavy armor units. Can switch between a musket (ranged) and an axe (melee). Deals +30% damage when stationary.
While HP is above 50%, gains +5 armor. Inspires nearby cavalry units, granting +10% attack speed.
Versatile Rus warship that can transform between a fishing vessel and a combat ship at a dock.

uniqueTech.effect: Horse Archers gain +1 range and +20% attack speed when moving.
Boyar units gain an additional +3 armor when at full HP and deal +15% bonus damage to unarmored units.
Streltsy gain +2 armor and their ranged attacks pierce through the first target in a line, hitting a second enemy.
